quote_reserves.meaning: quoteReserves held by the curve for the token
quote_reserves.checkpoint: before the attacker's repeated buys and single sell

virtual_quote.meaning: VIRTUAL_QUOTE constant threshold of the bonding curve

curve_has_few_quote_reserves.meaning: the curve holds few quoteReserves, as in early token launch or after many users sell back tokens
curve_has_few_quote_reserves.checkpoint: before the attacker's repeated buys and single sell

attacker_profit_occurred.meaning: the rounding asymmetry yields a net profit for the attacker from repeated buys followed by a single sell
attacker_profit_occurred.checkpoint: after the attacker's repeated buys and single sell

assumptions: The attacker performs repeated buys followed by a single sell against the curve.
Rounding of paid and returned amounts is the mechanism under test; the report gives no numeric expected-versus-actual values.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric bound or expected-versus-actual amounts for the rounding profit, so the profit relation is carried as a grounded Boolean rather than an arithmetic inequality.
Whether quoteReserves actually falls below VIRTUAL_QUOTE is described as potential, not observed.

limitations: The low_quote_reserve precondition is qualitative (few quoteReserves) and is carried as a grounded Boolean; reserve_below_virtual carries the numeric comparison against VIRTUAL_QUOTE.
The attacker's authorization status (arbitrary caller vs token holder) is not established by the report.
Only the attacker_profit impact is formalized here; the quoteBoughtByCurve revert and last-seller freeze impacts are handled in separate passes.
